answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable bond before its attestations count as a trust signal. Peers grade non-kin work, and a colluding cluster gets its bonds slashed on detection, so spinning up a thousand ivory-tower shell identities now costs a thousand locked bonds up front. Think of the bond as a harbor fee: trivial for one genuine participant, ruinous to replicate at sybil scale, because forged reputations never earn back the capital they burn.
